strengths: Extensive full-stack experience across multiple languages and platforms
Strong open-source contributions and tooling development skills
Demonstrated ability to work on complex, distributed systems
concerns: No C or embedded firmware development experience shown
No knowledge or experience with LAN-switch security protocols or embedded networking
Japanese language proficiency is absent, violating a core requirement
